actionSuppressionPartition.definition: No realised Shatter writes staggered, combat ends first, ordinary damage kills the enemy, or enemy-phase Smolder kills it before the stagger branch; no STAGGERED action skip occurs.
actionSuppressionPartition.reason: There is no enemy-action suppression mediator. Treating Shatter count or its unconditional outputs as sufficient would reopen the rejected generic family.

actionSuppressionPartition.definition: A further realised Shatter writes true over an already-true boolean before enemy-phase consumption and therefore cannot suppress a second action.
actionSuppressionPartition.reason: The boolean has no additional action-suppression state. Selecting repeat count or a harder pane would reopen the closed same-enemy reseam family.

actionSuppressionPartition.definition: Before enemy phase, Resonant Lance may read staggered as one of two conditions for its damage multiplier.
actionSuppressionPartition.reason: This is the exact rejected Resonant Lance shatterEcho package, not enemy-action suppression.

actionSuppressionPartition.definition: After Smolder, STAGGERED skips a current move with no authored dmg field.
actionSuppressionPartition.reason: The 47 moves divide into block, heal, buff and debuff actions with four distinct effect signatures. Pooling them would invent one scalar outcome; this audit neither selects nor closes any separately justified member.

actionSuppressionPartition.definition: After Smolder, STAGGERED consumes a living enemy's current authored move whose definition contains dmg, appends the move key to history and emits no ENEMY_ACT for that action.
actionSuppressionPartition.reason: This is an existing producer-consumer handshake between a Dusk-only realised Shatter and the downstream enemy action gate. It is not a new payoff after every Shatter, player-phase echo damage, player action economy or post-fight no-loss reward.

actionSuppressionPartition.definition: After either a skipped or executed action, Ritual gain and vulnerable/weak ticks still run.
actionSuppressionPartition.reason: These transitions are explicitly not suppressed by stagger and therefore are fixed downstream context, not part of the selected action gate.

authority: Apply decision boundary 1 and freeze only enemy-phase-damaging-intent-skip for one separately preregistered zero-new-row observability and capacity screen. Do not open a trace before its parser and gates are frozen, implement a factor, add telemetry, simulate, add a ledger row, use a protected seed or claim a package.

frontierScope.claimBoundary: This source-only audit may freeze at most one exact existing relation for a separate zero-new-row observability and upper-capacity preregistration. It cannot establish realised support, policy selectivity, causal benefit, complementarity, package admission, a research knob or product authority.

Resonant Lance damage echo or another player-phase stagger reader
poison transfer, enemy death, relic aftermath or fight-quality reward
pooling block, heal, buff and debuff moves into one non-damage scalar
card, enemy, act, formation, intent-label or damage-magnitude subset

frontierScope.included: The complete lifecycle of the existing enemy-local staggered boolean from realised Shatter through player-phase readers, lethal pre-emption and enemy-phase consumption, partitioned by the exact authored current move's native damage/non-damage boundary.

selectedRelation.actionScope: The whole authored damaging action is suppressed, including any attached block, heal, status, ramp, repeat or add-card effect. Those signatures are fixed natural heterogeneity, not separately varied factors.
selectedRelation.exactPredicate: In enemy phase after Smolder resolution, a living enemy enters the existing staggered branch and its current move definition has a dmg field; STAGGERED is emitted and ENEMY_ACT for that move is absent.
selectedRelation.name: Shatter interruption of a damaging authored intent
selectedRelation.nativeBoundary: preview_enemy_dmg is non-null for the current move
